jobs.title: Senior Product Manager
jobs.description: About Us: At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We're the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you encounter. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the memories you make. Through our products, partners and people, we make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Leadership/Team Quote "We are building our new Flights platform from the ground up, bridging complex aviation-specific financial operations with Booking.com's massive global scale. This is a rare zero-to-one opportunity to architect the future-state finance engine for a key travel vertical while working alongside world-class engineering and enterprise finance teams." Role Description As a Senior Product Manager for Flights Finance Operations, you will lead the early-stage discovery, strategy, and zero-to-one execution for our global flight settlement and reconciliation capabilities. You will bridge complex aviation clearinghouse and settlement requirements with Booking.com's centralized finance infrastructure, shaping the target operating model and driving technical design for flows of funds. Operating in a highly collaborative and matrixed environment, you will unify legacy processes with scalable future-state systems to power our growing Flights platform. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties: Own the 18-month product strategy and team objectives, converting complex aviation finance workflows into a clear technical blueprint for engineering teams. Lead early-stage zero-to-one discovery and end-to-end design for global flight financial reconciliation, settlement, and fund-flow systems. Manage product delivery, team backlog prioritization, and risk mitigation while ensuring strict adherence to baseline non-functional requirements (financial, legal, regulatory, security, and privacy). Collaborate with enterprise Finance teams (Treasury, Tax, General Ledger) and key cross-functional stakeholders to align on strategic priorities and resolve dependencies. Establish product success metrics, design experimentations, and apply advanced data analytics to guide strategy and prioritization decisions. Drive customer and operational insight synthesis, transforming system usage data, logs, and feedback into clear problem statements and scalable solutions. Qualifications & Skills: Product Craft Experience: 3–5 years of dedicated product management experience with a proven track record of driving complex technical capabilities. Aviation FinTech Background: Hands-on product experience in financial operations within travel distribution (e.g., major global OTA, airline distribution finance, GDS like Amadeus/Sabre, or flight consolidator). Aviation Clearinghouse Mastery: Deep, up-to-date expertise in global IATA BSP, ARC, and modern settlement frameworks (including NDC and settlement-with-order models). Zero-to-One Track Record: Demonstrated experience building or scaling a flight financial reconciliation ecosystem from the ground up. Enterprise Stakeholder Navigation: Strong ability to consult, influence, and align cross-functional teams within large-scale matrix organizations. Technical & Data Fluency: Proven ability to partner with Engineering/EMs on architectural trade-offs, system dependencies, non-functional requirements, and advanced data-driven experimentations. Education: Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience. Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance: Booking.com's Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include: Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave. Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country). Industry leading product discounts - up to €1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit. Inclusion at Booking.com: Inclusion has been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: "At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn't just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It's a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech." We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Application Process: Let's go places together: How we Hire. Note: Location is ideally Amsterdam, Netherlands, or remote-friendly within European time zones with expected monthly travel to Amsterdam. Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

jobs.title: Product Manager (Core Accounting)
jobs.description: Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer-facing brands - Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15.1 billion and $4.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion. Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units. At Booking.com, data drives our decisions. Technology is at our core. And innovation is everywhere. But our company is more than datasets, lines of code or A/B tests. We’re the thrill of the first night in a new place. The excitement of the next morning. The friends you make. The journeys you take. The sights you see. And the food you sample. Through our products, partners and people, we can empower everyone to experience the world. The Role The Record-to-Report (RTR) track is part of Booking Holdings’ Finance Technology and Enterprise Applications organization. The team builds and operates products that enable accurate, controlled and efficient financial accounting, reporting and period-end close across Booking Holdings. We are looking for a Product Manager to own and evolve products supporting the accounting lifecycle, including general ledger, revenue accounting, intercompany accounting, asset accounting, treasury accounting, reconciliations, financial controls, reporting and month-end close. The role sits at the intersection of Finance, Accounting, Product, Engineering, Data and Enterprise Technology. The Product Manager will translate complex accounting and operational needs into scalable product capabilities, while ensuring strong controls, auditability, data lineage and user experience. Our goal is to create a standardized and intelligent RTR platform that reduces manual effort, improves financial accuracy, accelerates the close and provides Finance users with timely insight into accounting health and control risks. What You'll Be Doing Define and own the product vision, strategy and roadmap for one or more RTR products or capabilities. Understand the needs of Accounting, Finance Operations, Controllers, Treasury Accounting, FP&A, Regional Finance and audit stakeholders. Translate accounting policies, business processes and control requirements into clear product requirements and scalable system solutions. Partner with Engineering, Enterprise Architects, Data Engineers, Analysts and implementation teams to design, build and operate products. Own and prioritize the product backlog based on business value, risk reduction, regulatory and control requirements, user needs and technical dependencies. Define success measures and monitor product performance, including automation rates, reconciliation coverage, exception volumes, manual effort, close timelines, posting quality and control adherence. Drive discovery, process mapping, solution evaluation and end-to-end delivery from problem definition through adoption and operationalization. Collaborate with Finance and Technology stakeholders to establish clear system ownership, data lineage and integration boundaries across SAP, data platforms and adjacent applications. Lead initiatives that improve the speed, accuracy and predictability of the month-end close. Ensure products meet security, compliance, audit, SOX and financial-control expectations. Partner with global stakeholders to standardize processes and support entity onboarding, organizational change and platform transformation. Communicate product decisions, priorities, risks, dependencies and outcomes to senior stakeholders. Work closely with users during testing, rollout and adoption to ensure that solutions are usable, controlled and fit for operational needs. Engage with other Product Managers across Finance Technology and Booking Holdings to align platform capabilities, development priorities and long-term architecture. What You'll Bring A minimum of 5 years of experience in Product Management, Business Analysis, Finance Technology, Accounting Systems or a related discipline. Overall experience of 8+ years in IT Roles is preferred Experience working with financial systems, ERP platforms or enterprise accounting products; SAP S/4HANA experience is strongly preferred. Good understanding of Record-to-Report processes, including general ledger, journal entries, accruals, reversals, intercompany accounting, reconciliations, asset accounting or financial close. Ability to communicate effectively with Finance and Accounting users as well as technical stakeholders, including Engineers, Architects, Data Engineers and Analysts. Experience converting complex business processes and accounting requirements into clear product requirements and practical technology solutions. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to structure ambiguous problems and evaluate alternative solutions. Ability to define meaningful product and operational metrics and use data to guide prioritization and decision-making. Experience working in a highly integrated enterprise environment with multiple systems, data sources, teams and dependencies. Understanding of financial controls, auditability, SOX requirements, data lineage and evidence management. Experience with reconciliation, financial reporting, workflow, automation or business intelligence products is an advantage. Experience working with platforms such as BlackLine, SAP Analytics Cloud, Snowflake, payment systems, treasury platforms or other Finance Technology solutions is a plus. Strong stakeholder-management and influencing skills, including the ability to align teams without direct authority. Ability to balance strategic thinking with attention to product details, operational realities and delivery execution. Collaborative, outcome-oriented and comfortable working in a global, fast-paced environment. Solution-oriented and results-driven, with a strong sense of ownership and accountability. We’re a truly global e-commerce company, with business operations in nearly every country and city on the planet. And we want to make it easy for everyone, anywhere in the world, to pay for their travel or do business with our platform - whenever and however it’s convenient for them. Through the Booking Holdings brands, we help our customers reach all corners of the earth. Our ability to provide great service rests on how well we understand our diverse customer base, which is why having a diverse team is so important to us. We bring together employees from all walks of life and we are proud to provide the kind of inclusive environment that stimulates innovation, creativity and collaboration. EEO Statement: Booking Holdings is an equal opportunity employer in accordance with all applicable federal, state and local laws. We ensure equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without discrimination or harassment based on race, religious creed, color, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, religion, marital status, medical condition, disability, military service, pregnancy, childbirth and related medical conditions, or any other classification protected by federal, state, or local law. jobs.title: Senior Product Manager - BKNG Ads
jobs.description: Booking.com is building a scalable, privacy-compliant, and intelligent travel media platform that we call BKNG Ads. The foundations created by this team will determine how quickly we can launch new capabilities, how effectively campaigns run, how safely data is activated, and how much leverage our teams can get from the tools they use. In this role, you will help turn a complex set of platforms and workflows into a coherent product ecosystem that can support Booking Ads growth. The BKNG AdTech team builds the capabilities that power BKNG Ads as a scalable travel media business. We connect ad-serving, audience, data, measurement, workflow, and operational tools so that campaigns can be delivered effectively and new advertising capabilities can be built quickly. Your work sits at the intersection of product, engineering, data, commercial operations, privacy, and external technology providers. You create the foundations that enable better targeting, measurement, automation, operational efficiency, and future commercial opportunities across BKNG Ads. As Senior Product Manager, BKNG AdTech, you will own the product strategy, roadmap, and execution for the integrated tools, workflows, and capabilities that make BKNG Ads faster, more scalable, and more effective. You will think and act beyond just Booking.com, building the enabling AdTech capabilities that support Priceline and Agoda's advertising initiatives. You will connect systems and teams to create capabilities that individual tools cannot provide on their own. You will identify opportunities to reduce friction, improve campaign delivery, activate data safely, and build reusable foundations for future products and partnerships. This role is ideal for a product leader who enjoys working across a complex ecosystem of ad technology, data, engineering, commercial operations, privacy, and external vendors. You do need to understand how these areas fit together and make sound product decisions across their interfaces. Key Responsibilities and Duties: Product strategy, delivery, and leadership Own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for BKNG AdTech capabilities, prioritizing high-value opportunities that balance business goals, technical effort, and operational impact. Drive discovery by gathering insights from stakeholders and users to inform roadmap decisions. Define requirements and success metrics, making informed build-versus-buy decisions in partnership with Engineering. Manage cross-functional dependencies and risks across Product, Ads Data, AdOps, Commercial, Legal, and external vendors. Validate outcomes through experimentation, communicating progress and strategic learnings clearly to senior leadership. Lead AdTech product direction across affected crafts (Engineering, AdOps, Commercial, Legal etc), aligning teams around a shared strategy and clear priorities. Represent the AdTech strategy in BKNG Ads planning and prioritisation forums. Data, targeting, measurement, privacy and operational effectiveness Partner with Engineering to enable privacy-safe audience activation, targeting, and measurement. Establish product foundations that support future data partnerships and evolving regulatory requirements. Ensure data quality, consent, and privacy are integrated by design into all product decisions. Collaborate with specialists on optimization and modeling where they deliver meaningful value. Partner with AdOps to understand operational pain points and ensure the tools they use are fit for purpose, effective, and scalable. Work together to improve workflows, quality controls, and reporting and observability across campaign setup and delivery. Support consistent adoption of new tools and workflows through clear requirements, rollout plans, documentation, and feedback loops. Rationalize fragmented workflows and tools into coherent systems that drive business value at scale. Define how ad servers, data, and measurement systems work together to build impactful, scalable capabilities. Commercial and financial enablement Work with Commercial and other product teams to understand the capabilities required to support advertiser value and future propositions. Enable data and technology partnerships through strong product and technical foundations. Understand downstream billing, reconciliation, and financial dependencies, partnering with FinTech where billing integration or financial-system changes are required; billing integration is owned by the FinTech team. Qualifications & Skills: Minimum of 7 years of experience in ad tech, travel media, and martech Minimum of 5 years of experience in a Product Management role, working with engineers, prioritizing business problems, and owning roadmaps for your team(s). Experience integrating vendors, platforms, and data systems in strict compliance and regulatory environments. Experience working with data activation, measurement, monetization, and privacy technologies in the advertising space. Product leader with experience owning complex AdTech/MarTech platforms and data-enabled integrations, comfortable navigating the combination of business goals, engineering realities, and day to day operations. Strong prioritizer, using qualitative and quantitative insights to drive strategy in ambiguous or high growth environments. Collaborative builder of trust and alignment with diverse stakeholders. Skilled translator of complex technical or business topics into clear, actionable requirements. Privacy-literate, with a solid grasp of consent, data governance, and regulatory requirements. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. jobs.title: Director of Product, Attractions
jobs.description: About Booking.com Established in 1996 in Amsterdam, Booking.com has grown from a small Dutch start-up to one of the largest ecommerce companies in the world. Booking.com is the largest business within Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) and accounts for the vast majority of Booking Holdings’ total revenue. Booking Holdings is a leading Fortune 500 e-commerce conglomerate with a market cap of roughly $166 Billion (2025). Booking.com currently employs approximately 12,000 employees in 140 offices in 70 countries worldwide. With a mission to make it easier for everyone to experience the world, Booking.com invests in digital technology that helps take the friction out of travel. Booking.com connects travelers with the world’s largest selection of incredible places to stay, including everything from apartments, vacation homes, and family-run B&Bs to 5-star luxury resorts and even tree houses. jobs.title: Director of Product, Foundations
jobs.description: About Booking.com Established in 1996 in Amsterdam, Booking.com has grown from a small Dutch start-up to one of the largest ecommerce companies in the world. Booking.com is the largest business within Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) and accounts for the vast majority of Booking Holdings’ total revenue. Booking Holdings is a leading Fortune 500 e-commerce conglomerate with a market cap of roughly $166 billion (2025). Booking.com currently employs approximately 13,000 employees in 140 offices in 70 countries worldwide. With a mission to make it easier for everyone to experience the world, Booking.com invests in digital technology that helps take the friction out of travel. Booking.com connects travelers with the world’s largest selection of incredible places to stay, including everything from apartments, vacation homes, and family-run B&Bs to 5-star luxury resorts and even tree houses. The Booking.com website and mobile apps are available in over 44 languages, offer more than 28M total reported listings, and cover over 174,000 destinations in 229 countries worldwide. Offering 30 different types of places to stay, including homes, apartments, B&Bs, hostels, farm stays, bungalows, even boats, igloos, and treehouses. So whether travelling for business or leisure, customers can instantly book their ideal accommodation quickly and easily, without booking fees and backed up by its promise to match. Via the customer experience team, customers can reach Booking.com 24/7 for assistance and support in over 44 languages, any time of the day or night. At Booking.com, we are all involved in making hundreds of decisions every day. The decisions we make are a reflection of our Values - they reflect what is important to us, both as individuals and as an organisation. When Values are made explicit, they provide clarity on what “good” looks like. And when they are shared, they build unity in a group. They build culture. Think customer first. We obsess about adding value for our customers - guests, partners, colleagues - to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Own it. We deliver on our promises, make informed decisions and prioritize to get the important things done today. Learn forever. We are resilient, take time to reflect, and seek to learn – from colleagues, from the outside world and from our failures. Succeed together. We celebrate team success, through making connections, building trust and valuing the diverse perspectives of others. Do the right thing. We get the right results the right way. For each other, our communities and the world around us. Profile As Director of Product, Foundations, you will lead the Foundations product organisation within Marketplace Product Experience, owning the strategy and direction for the shared digital experience platform that every Booking.com experience team builds on. The mission is simple and high‑leverage: enable other teams to move faster by providing reliable, reusable, AI-first platform capabilities — so missions and verticals spend their energy on differentiated customer value rather than rebuilding undifferentiated infrastructure. Operating at Product Director scope, you are responsible for multiple platform product groups: Experience Infrastructure, Experience Content and Experience UI, plus cross‑platform orchestration — and accountable for customer impact, business impact and Product Quality / Excellence across the portfolio. Because Foundations is a horizontal enabler, your success is measured as much by the leverage, adoption and velocity you create for consuming teams as by the platforms themselves. Key responsabilities Product vision, strategy and outcomes Own the Foundations platform strategy and set a clear 18 month direction for the shared digital experience platform, translating company, Marketplace and Tech Enablement strategy into a prioritised platform portfolio with sharp build/buy/reuse trade‑offs. Define the strategic narrative and sequencing of major platform bets across Experience Infrastructure, Experience Content, Experience UI and orchestration, including where AI becomes a first‑class platform capability. Own department‑level outcomes and a measurable performance narrative built on platform leverage metrics — adoption, consuming‑team velocity, reuse, reliability, total cost of ownership and reduction of duplicated logic — linked to the customer and business outcomes the platforms enable. Organisation leadership and delivery Lead the Foundations organisation across multiple platform product groups, driving multi‑year planning and resource allocation while balancing near‑term enablement needs with long‑term architecture investment. Ensure delivery excellence and raise the bar on product quality — reliability, maintainability, compliance, cost efficiency, operational health and adherence to NFRs — for capabilities that the whole company depends on. Lead the migration from fragmented, team‑specific infrastructure, content and UI toward shared, reusable platforms, ensuring capabilities are operationally ready, well‑documented and adopted, and that duplicated and legacy implementations are deprecated. Cross‑functional and cross‑organisational collaboration Partner with Engineering leadership on multi‑year architectural investment decisions that shape the experience platform, the content stack, the UI/design‑system foundations and the orchestration layer, and their fit within Booking.com's broader technology direction. Run a disciplined platform‑as‑a‑service operating model with consuming teams: clear contracts, SLAs, intake and prioritisation, roadmaps and adoption commitments, so platform investment tracks real consuming‑team demand and company‑level leverage. Lead complex cross‑BU initiatives where platform decisions intersect with missions, verticals and platform teams across the company, and represent Foundations in VP / SVP‑level forums with clear options, trade‑offs and decision requests. People leadership and product craft Develop leaders, design and evolve the organisation structure so scope, decision ownership and accountability are clear, and hire, coach and performance‑manage senior PMs and GPMs for strong team and portfolio health. Lead as a true people manager with clear delegation and direct feedback, and contribute beyond core scope to Marketplace PX, platform craft and the wider PM craft — including platform product standards, AI product thinking and reusable practices. Platform domain – specific responsibilities Own Experience Infrastructure as the reliable, scalable runtime, rendering, delivery and experimentation foundation that consuming experiences are built on, spanning: Data Access — the federated data mediation layer that gives product teams governed, discoverable, privacy‑compliant data and reduces cognitive load; Gateway & Traffic Enrichment — the unified entry, routing and deep‑linking layer that enriches traveller traffic with standardised Common Request Context for consistent, secure, observable handling across verticals; and App Build & Release — the end‑to‑end mobile delivery pipeline (CI/CD, release orchestration and SRE) that drives reliability, self‑service releases and faster, safer mobile delivery at 125M+ MAU scale. Own Experience Content platforms so content can be authored once and delivered consistently across surfaces and locales, spanning: Content Moderation — scalable integrity, compliance and governance workflows that keep user‑ and partner‑generated content safe and legally compliant; Localization — the translation and multilingual delivery infrastructure that powers locally relevant experiences at scale; and Content Generation — large‑scale text and visual content, GenAI creation workflows and writing systems that deliver relevance and consistency efficiently across journeys. Own Experience UI — the reusable component library, design system, screen composition and front‑end frameworks — so teams build consistent, accessible, high‑quality interfaces faster, with consistency across web and app. Own the orchestration layer that lets infrastructure, content and UI capabilities be composed into experiences, exposing clear contracts and self‑service tooling so consuming teams can assemble experiences quickly. Steward the conversational foundations that bring Conversational AI across the traveller journey, providing the shared, reusable building blocks (and integration into the MP AI north‑star architecture) that let conversational experiences be built and scaled consistently rather than rebuilt per use case. Make AI a first‑class platform capability, partnering with Engineering, Data and ML leaders to embed AI/ML and GenAI into infrastructure, content, UI and conversational foundations with responsible‑AI guardrails, so consuming teams inherit safe, scalable AI by default. Establish shared platform principles, adoption playbooks, versioning and deprecation discipline, and a feedback loop with consuming teams so the platform continuously improves against real usage. Ideal Experience & Skills: Required Extensive product leadership experience (10+ years), including several years leading multiple PM teams and managers at Product Director scope (multiple product groups, multi‑year strategy, complex cross‑BU initiatives) in a complex, global environment. A track record in platform, infrastructure, developer‑tooling, content platform or design‑system / UI platform product at scale, ideally where the customers were internal teams and success was measured in adoption, leverage and velocity. Strong platform product thinking: comfortable running a platform‑as‑a‑service model with contracts, SLAs, intake/prioritisation and adoption strategy, and reasoning in terms of reuse, total cost of ownership, build/buy/reuse and duplication reduction. Strong Applied AI Product Proficiency and Tech Fluency: able to evaluate where AI becomes a platform capability, govern responsible AI use, and partner deeply on architecture, reliability, maintainability and long‑term technical health. Excellent stakeholder leadership and Strategic Thinking, able to influence senior leaders and consuming teams through structured narratives, options and clear decision framing. Strong command of English, written and spoken. Preferred Background in travel, marketplaces or large consumer digital products, working at the intersection of platform capabilities, content systems, front‑end/design systems, AI / ML systems and the experience teams that consume them. Depending on the vacancy and applicable law, a pre-employment screening may include employment history, education and other information (such as media information) that may be necessary for determining your qualifications and suitability for the position.

Own complex ServiceNow projects and programme workstreams end to end. Coordinate Product, Engineering, Architecture, QA, Operations, business stakeholders and vendors. Manage risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies and decisions, with clear owners and escalation paths. Make delivery health visible through Jira, Confluence and evidence-based stakeholder communication. Connect process change, configuration or development, integrations, data, testing, communications, training, adoption and operational readiness into one delivery plan. Drive decisions when work is blocked rather than simply reporting the blocker. Manage vendors against scope, milestones, quality, acceptance criteria and knowledge transfer. Ensure initiatives are ready for production, supported after go-live and able to exit hypercare sustainably. Protect engineering capacity by making planned delivery, KTLO and unplanned demand visible. Use pragmatic Agile, hybrid and programme-management practices appropriate to the work. Use AI tools and automation thoughtfully to improve reporting, trend analysis, risk detection and stakeholder communication while retaining human judgement and accountability. Share reusable delivery patterns, lessons learned and improvements with the wider TPM community. Role Qualifications and Requirements: Significant experience in Senior Project Manager, Program Manager, Senior Program Manager or Technical Programme Manager roles. Approximately five or more years of programme or project-management experience, including meaningful ownership of technical programmes. Two or more years in a clearly technical programme-management role is preferred. Experience delivering complex, cross-functional enterprise technology change. Strong planning, execution, risk-management and dependency-management skills. The ability to create integrated plans across multiple technical and business teams. Experience working with Product, Engineering, Architecture, Security, Risk, Compliance, QA, Operations and business stakeholders. The confidence to influence, challenge and resolve conflict without formal authority. Strong written and verbal communication, from working-team discussions to senior leadership updates. Experience with testing, release, production readiness, operational handover and early-life support. Comfort using Jira, Confluence or equivalent tools as a reliable delivery system of record. A track record of taking personal ownership for outcomes, including difficult trade-offs, missed commitments, escalations and lessons learned. Nice-to-Have Skills: ServiceNow experience, particularly ITOM, ITAM, ITSM, Now Assist, WSD or LSD. Experience with CMDB, CSDM, enterprise data quality, data modelling or asset management. Experience delivering integrations involving APIs, data contracts, bi-directional synchronisation or multiple enterprise systems. Experience with regulated change, auditability, control evidence, financial services or DORA / ITDR-related environments. Experience managing implementation partners or blended internal and vendor teams. Experience with Jira Advanced Roadmaps, Jira Align or equivalent portfolio tooling. Experience with adoption, communications, training and operating-model change. Experience connecting delivery outcomes to OKRs, KPIs, value cases or benefits realisation. ITIL, PMP, PgMP, PMI-ACP, PRINCE2, SAFe, Scrum or Lean Six Sigma certification. ServiceNow expertise is valuable, but it is not the only route into this role. We are interested in strong enterprise-platform, workflow, data, automation or AI-enabled change leaders who can demonstrate the delivery craft required for the role. Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance: Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits. We offer a competitive compensation and benefits package, as well unique-to-Booking.com benefits which include: Annual paid time off and generous paid leave scheme including: parent, grandparent, bereavement, and care leave Hybrid working including flexible working arrangements, and up to 20 days per year working from abroad (home country) Industry leading product discounts - up to 1400 per year - for yourself, including automatic Genius Level 3 status and Booking.com wallet credit Diversity, Equity and Inclusion (DEI) at Booking.com: Diversity, Equity & Inclusion have been a core part of our company culture since day one. This ongoing journey starts with our very own employees, who represent over 140 nationalities and a wide range of ethnic and social backgrounds, genders and sexual orientations. Take it from our Chief People Officer, Paulo Pisano: “At Booking.com, the diversity of our people doesn’t just build an outstanding workplace, it also creates a better and more inclusive travel experience for everyone. Inclusion is at the heart of everything we do. It’s a place where you can make your mark and have a real impact in travel and tech.” We ensure that colleagues with disabilities are provided the adjustments and tools they need to participate in the job application and interview process, to perform crucial job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Application Process: This role does not come with relocation assistance. We use a structured, evidence-based process designed to assess both delivery capability and alignment with how we work at Booking.com. The process includes: Recruiter conversation. Craft and domain interview 1. Craft and domain interview 2. Final Booking.com FIT interview focused on learning agility, customer and commercial awareness, problem-solving, communication and values. The role does not require a coding test. We are looking for technical fluency and delivery judgement rather than software implementation. Let’s go places together: How we Hire Booking.com is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, or veteran status. We strive to move well beyond traditional equal opportunity and work to create an environment that allows everyone to thrive. jobs.title: Technical Product Manager - Experimentation
jobs.description: Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and related services, provided to customers and partners in over 220 countries and territories through six primary consumer-facing brands - Booking.com, KAYAK, Priceline, Agoda.com, Rentalcars.com, and OpenTable. The mission of Booking Holdings is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. During 2019, the Company had consolidated revenues and net income of $15.1 billion and $4.9 billion, respectively, and a current market value of approximately $90 billion. Booking Holdings Bangalore is a Center of Excellence based in Bangalore, India and a legal entity of Booking Holdings Inc. The Center was created to support the increasing business demands of the Booking Holdings Brands. The Center of Excellence provides access to specialized and highly skilled talent, leading industry best practices, and collaboration opportunities across all of the Booking Holdings brands and business units. We’re a truly global e-commerce company, with business operations in nearly every country and city on the planet. And we want to make it easy for everyone, anywhere in the world, to pay for their travel or do business with our platform - whenever and however it’s convenient for them. Role description The Technical Product Manager for Application & Discovery Platform owns the product direction for the platform layer that connects Experimentation to the teams and areas across the company that use its capabilities. This includes the capabilities that make Experimentation discoverable, accessible, and usable by both humans and agents: GraphQL federation, MCP server capabilities, search and discovery experiences, notifications, and the UI shell. This role focuses on how Experimentation capabilities are exposed, consumed, and orchestrated across interfaces and systems. The Technical Product Manager works closely with engineering, design, analytics, and stakeholder teams to ensure the platform enables reliable integration patterns, intuitive discovery, and responsive, event-driven experiences. The person in this role is a technical product manager with a strong understanding of platform product management and solid experimentation knowledge. They should be able to engage credibly with data and engineering professionals, and translate their needs into product direction and priorities. They operate effectively at the intersection of product strategy, APIs, system design, developer experience, and experimentation workflows. They are highly customer-focused and develop a deep understanding of end-user needs, pain points, and workflows. They use that understanding to prioritise effectively, shape a roadmap that improves internal usability and ecosystem leverage, and drive adoption across the teams that rely on Experimentation capabilities. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties Defines the product strategy for Application & Discovery Platform in line with the wider Experimentation track strategy. Identifies the highest-value platform opportunities that improve discoverability, interoperability, and ease of consumption for Experimentation capabilities. jobs.title: Product Manager - Treasury & Enterprise Applications, FinTech
jobs.description: Booking Holdings (NASDAQ: BKNG) is the world leader in online travel and services that support the entire travel journey. Our platforms – including Booking.com, Priceline, Agoda, KAYAK and OpenTable – utilize advanced AI, machine learning and other innovative technologies to simplify and personalize the travel experience for consumers and partners in over 220 countries and territories. Our mission is to make it easier for everyone to experience the world. Role Description We are looking for a seasoned Product Manager to lead our enterprise Treasury product suite. The role sits at the intersection of Treasury, Finance, enterprise platforms and applied AI. You will be the key link between Treasury business needs and the product capabilities that support them, translating complex financial requirements into a clear product vision and roadmap. You will develop a deep understanding of how Treasury specialists work, where their time goes and what breaks, and use that insight to improve adoption, effectiveness and scalability across the Treasury ecosystem. AI is an important part of the future-state Treasury landscape. You will help identify where AI and automation can improve, simplify or strengthen Treasury processes, while ensuring that solutions are practical, appropriately controlled and aligned with the needs of a regulated finance environment. You will help shape the future-state Enterprise Applications ecosystem around FIS Quantum and related platforms, rather than simply reinforcing legacy systems and processes. Key Job Responsibilities and Duties Define the product strategy and roadmap for Treasury processes in line with the wider Booking Holdings Enterprise Applications and Finance strategies Build strong customer understanding by working with Treasury specialists to identify user needs, process pain points, data challenges and opportunities for improvement Partner with the business to identify and shape appropriate AI and automation opportunities that improve Treasury outcomes, reduce manual effort and support scale Translate business needs into clear product direction and priorities, working closely with Finance, data and engineering professionals Ensure that AI-enabled capabilities are designed with appropriate data access, human oversight, auditability and control requirements in mind Shape the future-state product and platform landscape, framing trade-offs between flexibility, standardisation, speed, cost and long-term adoption Ensure the team is solving meaningful user and business problems, not just delivering technical components Define and use outcome measures such as adoption, efficiency, cost reductions, quality and process improvement to guide product decisions Drive collaboration and alignment across Treasury stakeholders globally Create clear ways of working, communication rhythms and decision-making practices that enable effective cross-functional and cross-location collaboration Qualifications & Skills A minimum of 4 years of experience in a Product Manager role; enterprise or platform product management experience is a strong plus Ability to define and drive a clear product vision and translate that vision into priorities and roadmap decisions Working knowledge of AI and Machine Learning capabilities, with the ability to identify where they can create practical value and where they are not the right solution Experience working with AI- or ML-enabled capabilities, automation or data-driven products is a strong plus Familiarity with the Treasury technology landscape, including FIS Quantum or a comparable Treasury Management System, is a strong plus Proven experience in Treasury, including multi-entity and multi-currency environments Understanding of regulated financial processes, in-house banking, trading on behalf, hedging, is a strong plus Experience working on system design, platform interfaces or other integration-heavy systems Strong analytical, problem-solving, with the ability to use data to inform decisions Exceptional and confident stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate complex senior stakeholder dynamics and constructively challenge expert perspectives. Demonstrates strong organizational awareness with the ability to build alignment and drive outcomes across a complex multi-brand and global landscape Experience working within matrixed, ambiguous environments and understanding of the Treasury dynamics within the broader Enterprise Fintech ecosystem Solid understanding of agile software development processes and technologies for effective collaboration Ability to communicate at all levels with clarity and precision, both written and verbal Benefits & Perks - Global Impact, Personal Relevance Booking.com’s Total Rewards Philosophy is not only about compensation but also about benefits.
